title: Personalize Outreach Emails at Scale
tip: Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft personalized email variations for different alumni segments. Give the AI your standard template plus key details about the segment (graduation year, major, region, giving history) and ask it to rewrite the message so it resonates with that group. You can generate 10 segment-specific drafts in the time it used to take to write one.
action: Try it today: Paste your next appeal email into an AI tool and ask it to rewrite it for 3 different alumni personas—a recent grad, a mid-career professional, and a retiree.

title: Draft Thank-You Notes in Seconds
tip: AI can generate warm, genuine-sounding thank-you notes for donors in moments. Provide the AI with the donor's name, gift amount, the fund it supports, and one personal detail (if you have it), and ask for a 150-word thank-you note. Review and tweak the output—it will handle the heavy lifting.
action: Try it today: Write a prompt like 'Draft a thank-you note to [Name] who gave $500 to the scholarship fund. They graduated in 1998 from the School of Business.' See how close it gets on the first try.

title: Generate Event Announcement Copy
tip: Stop staring at a blank page before homecoming, reunions, or networking events. Describe your event to an AI—date, location, audience, theme, key activities—and ask for a full announcement, a short social post, and a subject line. You'll have three ready-to-edit assets in under a minute.
action: Try it today: Use this prompt template: 'Write an event announcement, a 280-character social post, and an email subject line for [event name] on [date] at [location] for [audience].'

title: Summarize Long Donor Reports
tip: When you receive lengthy annual reports, impact statements, or program updates, paste the text into an AI tool and ask for a 3-bullet executive summary. This gives you talking points for donor conversations and stewardship calls without reading the full document every time.
action: Try it today: Take any report you've been meaning to read and ask an AI: 'Summarize this in 5 bullet points a donor would care about.'

title: Brainstorm Reunion Programming Ideas
tip: AI is an excellent brainstorming partner. Describe your reunion audience—class year, typical interests, budget range—and ask for 15 programming ideas. You'll get a mix of obvious and creative options. Pick the 2–3 that fit your context and let the list inspire variations.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Give me 15 reunion event ideas for Class of 2000 alumni, mostly professionals in their mid-40s, budget is moderate, venue is on campus.'

title: Write Compelling Award Nominations
tip: Nominating an alum for a distinguished award but struggling with the narrative? Share the nominee's bio, accomplishments, and award criteria with an AI and ask it to draft the nomination letter. It will structure the argument for you—then you add the personal color and specific anecdotes.
action: Try it today: List 5 facts about an award-worthy alum and ask an AI to draft a 400-word nomination letter explaining why they deserve the award.

title: Create Volunteer Recruitment Scripts
tip: Recruiting alumni volunteers for calling campaigns, mentorship programs, or event committees? AI can write compelling recruitment pitches tailored to different motivators—career connection, giving back, staying involved. Generate several versions and A/B test them.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Write a 2-paragraph email recruiting alumni volunteers for a student mentorship program, emphasizing the personal fulfillment and professional networking benefits.'

title: Research Prospect Backgrounds Quickly
tip: Before a major gift meeting, ask an AI to help you organize your research. Paste in LinkedIn bio snippets, news mentions, and giving history, and ask for a one-page briefing document with key talking points. AI won't find the information for you, but it excels at synthesizing what you've gathered.
action: Try it today: Before your next prospect meeting, dump your notes into an AI and ask: 'Organize this into a briefing with: background, connection to the university, potential interests, and suggested conversation openers.'

title: Draft Talking Points for Phonathon Callers
tip: AI can write caller scripts that feel natural rather than robotic. Describe your campaign goal, the caller audience (students), and common objections you hear. Ask for a call script plus a 'handling objections' reference card. Students will sound more confident and authentic.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Write a 3-minute phonathon script for student callers asking alumni to renew their annual fund gift. Include responses to: I already gave, I'm not interested, and I need to think about it.'

title: Analyze Survey Results with AI
tip: After an alumni survey, paste open-ended responses into an AI tool and ask it to identify common themes, recurring complaints, and frequently mentioned suggestions. This saves hours of manual coding and gives you a narrative summary you can share with leadership.
action: Try it today: Take 20 open-ended survey responses and ask an AI: 'What are the top 5 themes in these alumni comments? What are they most satisfied with? Most frustrated by?'

title: Generate Social Media Content Calendars
tip: AI can plan a month of alumni-focused social media posts in minutes. Describe your channels, upcoming events, and content pillars (spotlights, events, impact stories, trivia) and ask for a 30-day content calendar with post copy for each day. Edit to match your voice.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Create a 2-week Instagram content calendar for a university alumni office. Include alumni spotlights, event promotions, giving season content, and school pride posts. Write the caption for each.'

title: Write Impact Stories from Raw Data
tip: You have scholarship recipient reports, program data, and outcome statistics—but turning them into a compelling donor story takes time. Feed the raw information to an AI and ask for a 300-word impact story written for a donor audience. The AI handles the narrative arc; you verify the facts.
action: Try it today: Take a scholarship recipient's report and ask AI: 'Turn this into a 250-word story a donor would be moved to read, focusing on impact and human connection.'

title: Build FAQ Documents for Your Team
tip: Compile answers to the most common alumni and donor questions into a document, then use AI to expand, clarify, and format it into a polished FAQ. Share it with new staff or volunteers to get them up to speed faster.
action: Try it today: List 10 questions you hear frequently and ask AI to write clear, friendly answers for each in 2–3 sentences.

title: Repurpose Long-Form Content
tip: Have a great alumni magazine article or annual report? AI can repurpose it into a donor email, a social post, a talking point for calls, and a short newsletter blurb—all in one prompt. One piece of content becomes five with minimal extra effort.
action: Try it today: Paste an article or story and ask: 'Repurpose this into: (1) a 150-word donor email, (2) a LinkedIn post, (3) three bullet points for a newsletter, (4) a quote graphic caption.'

title: Improve Your Email Subject Lines
tip: Open rates live or die by subject lines. Write your email, then ask AI to generate 10 subject line options—some curiosity-driven, some direct, some urgency-based. Pick the strongest one or test two against each other.
action: Try it today: Take any email you're about to send and prompt: 'Give me 10 subject line options for this email. Include: 2 that create urgency, 2 that ask a question, 2 that are short and direct, and 4 creative variations.'

title: Draft Grant and Corporate Partnership Proposals
tip: AI is a strong first-draft writer for grant proposals. Share the funding opportunity description, your program details, and outcomes data. Ask for a draft that follows the grant's structure. You'll spend time on accuracy and specifics, but the framing and persuasive language come quickly.
action: Try it today: Find a corporate partnership opportunity and prompt AI: 'Draft a 1-page partnership proposal for [company] to sponsor our mentorship program. Benefits to them: brand visibility, employee engagement, talent pipeline.'

title: Create Segmentation Criteria with AI Help
tip: Not sure how to segment your alumni database for a campaign? Describe your campaign goal to an AI and ask it to suggest segmentation criteria and the rationale for each. It can help you think through factors like giving capacity, engagement level, affinity, and recency.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'I'm running an annual fund email campaign. Suggest 6 ways I could segment alumni and explain what message would work best for each segment.'

title: Use AI as a Copyeditor
tip: Before sending any major communication, paste it into an AI and ask for: grammar corrections, clarity improvements, tone check (is it warm? urgent? grateful?), and any confusing sentences. It's like having a copy editor available 24/7 for free.
action: Try it today: Paste your next major donor email into an AI and ask: 'Edit this for grammar, clarity, and warmth. Flag any sentences that might confuse or put off a reader.'

title: Write Stewardship Report Narratives
tip: Annual stewardship reports for major donors require compelling narratives. Describe the fund's activity, beneficiaries, and outcomes, and ask AI to write the narrative sections. You provide facts and photos; AI shapes them into a story the donor will value.
action: Try it today: Take data from one fund's year-end report and prompt: 'Write a 200-word narrative for a stewardship report explaining how this scholarship fund impacted students this year.'

title: Prepare for Difficult Donor Conversations
tip: Use AI to role-play challenging donor conversations before they happen. Describe the donor situation and ask AI to play the donor and raise common concerns. Practice your responses. You'll feel more confident and less caught off guard.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Role-play as a major donor who is frustrated that their named fund hasn't been used this year. I'll practice responding. Start the conversation.'

title: Generate Alumni Spotlight Interview Questions
tip: Interviewing an alum for a spotlight feature? Share their bio and career background with AI and ask for 15 interview questions—covering their university experience, career journey, and advice for current students. You'll get a strong mix of questions in seconds.
action: Try it today: Paste a LinkedIn profile or bio and ask: 'Generate 15 interview questions for an alumni spotlight feature. Make them conversational, warm, and varied in topic.'

title: Translate Communications for International Alumni
tip: AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude are solid translators for alumni communications. If you have international alumni chapters, run key announcements through AI for a first-pass translation, then have a native speaker review. This is far faster than waiting for professional translation.
action: Try it today: Take your next event announcement and ask an AI to translate it into Spanish, Mandarin, or another language relevant to your alumni community.

title: Summarize Board Meeting Prep Materials
tip: Volunteer board members are busy. Use AI to distill lengthy board packets into a one-page executive summary with key decisions needed, key metrics, and context. Board members come better prepared, and your meetings run more efficiently.
action: Try it today: Take a board packet and prompt: 'Summarize this into a one-page briefing covering: key updates, decisions needed, and financial highlights.'

title: Draft Peer-to-Peer Fundraising Messages
tip: Peer fundraising works when alumni advocates have compelling messages to share. Write one great template, then ask AI to create 5 variations—different tones, lengths, and hooks—so each volunteer can choose one that feels authentic to them.
action: Try it today: Write one peer fundraising message and ask AI to create 4 variations: one emotional, one data-driven, one humorous, one brief and direct.

title: Create a Giving Day Communications Timeline
tip: Giving days require a precise multi-channel communication sequence. Describe your giving day timeline to AI and ask it to draft the full communications calendar—pre-launch tease, day-of morning email, midday social push, evening stretch goal message, and thank-you wrap-up—with copy for each.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Plan and write the communications timeline for a 24-hour giving day. Include: teaser email 1 week out, launch email, 3 social posts during the day, a text message, and a thank-you email.'

title: Write Lapsed Donor Re-engagement Emails
tip: Winning back lapsed donors requires the right tone—acknowledging the gap without making them feel guilty. AI can draft re-engagement emails that are warm, curiosity-driven, and low-pressure. Give it the lapse window (1 year, 3 years, 5+ years) and ask for tone-matched drafts.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Write a re-engagement email for alumni donors who haven't given in 3 years. Tone should be warm and curious, not guilt-inducing. Include a soft ask with a low entry gift amount.'

title: Build a Resource Library for New Staff
tip: Use AI to help you document institutional knowledge. Describe a process (like how you handle major gift acknowledgment) and ask AI to help you write a clear, step-by-step SOP. Over time, build a full resource library your team can reference.
action: Try it today: Pick one process you do regularly and prompt: 'Help me write a standard operating procedure for [process]. Ask me clarifying questions if needed, then write the step-by-step guide.'

title: Craft Endowment Description Language
tip: Describing endowment gifts clearly can be tricky—you need to convey permanence, impact, and legacy without being overly technical. Ask AI to help you write endowment descriptions for different audiences: donors, students, board members, and the general public.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'Write 4 descriptions of what an endowed scholarship means—one for a prospective donor, one for a scholarship recipient, one for a board member, and one for a social media post.'

title: Improve Your Bio and Case Statements
tip: Your case for support and institutional bios can get stale. Paste them into AI and ask for a fresh rewrite with more active language, stronger verbs, and a clearer value proposition. Then review and keep what resonates.
action: Try it today: Paste your current case for support or alumni office mission statement and ask: 'Rewrite this to be more compelling and donor-centered. Use active voice and focus on impact.'

title: Use AI to Plan the Year Strategically
tip: At the start of each planning cycle, share your annual goals, major campaigns, and constraints with an AI. Ask it to help you map out a month-by-month communications and engagement calendar. Use the output as a starting framework you refine with your team.
action: Try it today: Prompt: 'I work in alumni relations. My goals this year are [X, Y, Z]. Help me build a month-by-month communications calendar that supports these goals, with key themes and activities for each month.'
